name: Q*Bird
description: Q*Bird is a quantum communication company offering Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution (MDI-QKD) systems under the Falqon® product line. The company provides the highest level of QKD security by removing the detector side-channel attack surface. Q*Bird was spun out of QuTech (TU Delft / TNO) and received an EIC Accelerator grant and equity investment totalling €7.5M in 2025–2026.
funding: €7.5M EIC Accelerator (€2.5M grant + €5M equity, signed January 2026); €1M EFRO grant March 2025
